CustomField.description: Revenue concentration: this division's T12M revenue as a share of its parent's total. Cross-object formula with divide-by-zero guard; returns blank (renders as dash) until ParentRollupBatch populates Parent_Revenue_T12M__c. Spec Section 5.1.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Parent.Parent_Revenue_T12M__c), Parent.Parent_Revenue_T12M__c = 0 ), null, Division_Revenue_T12M__c / Parent.Parent_Revenue_T12M__c )
CustomField.label: Revenue Concentration %
